hybrid.rule: PPO on odd queries; verified bracket on even queries, Random if no bracket
hybrid.criterion: PPO has not lowered tuning error by at least 1% over value greedy

evaluation.target: 60 physical resource/dispatch outcomes and 3 recovery labels; not four physical risk warning heads
evaluation.scope: Source-held-out reuse; historical cal sources, not newly collected confirm

diagnostics.scope: Post-freeze independent-source diagnostics; oracle information never selects training data or checkpoints
